name: Shintan
description: Personal guard of Khan Narset at Sage Eye Stronghold in Tarkir's original timeline.

description_citations.text: "Shintan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset slips away from her required solitary meditation, leaving a decoy with a melon for a head to fool her guard Shintan.
timeline.quote: I quickly constructed my decoy, dressed in the same clothes, complete with a melon for a head I had stored here the night before.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Returning to the pavilion, Narset finds eight Disowned orcs holding Shintan and her decoy destroyed.
timeline.quote: I made it to the rock face and climbed back up to the pavilion to find eight Abzan orcs standing within.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Shintan frees himself and defeats his captors, and the two end the fight with orcs dead and wounded on the marble floor.
timeline.quote: The orcs lay, some dead, all bleeding, on the marble floor of the sacred temple.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Shintan reports that an orc said Taigam hired them in revenge for an assassination attempt Narset allegedly sent; Narset denies knowing of any assassins.
timeline.quote: He said he and his kin were hired by the rat Taigam.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The imprisoned orcs all tell the same story, but the elders accept that they are lying; Narset concludes Tarkir is sick with war.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset sneaks away from her meditation, leaving a decoy for Shintan to watch.
timeline.quote: She quickly constructed a decoy, dressed in the same clothes

citation.text: "Shintan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eight orcs ambush the plaza and hold Shintan; Narset finds her decoy destroyed.
timeline.quote: she found eight formerly Abzan orcs standing within, holding Shintan

citation.text: "Shintan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset and Shintan fight off and defeat the orcs.
timeline.quote: Narset delivered a kick to the commander orc's throat.

citation.text: "Shintan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shintan reveals the orcs were hired by Taigam; the elders doubt the orcs.
timeline.quote: they had been hired by the traitor Taigam

citation.text: "Shintan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Narset's personal guard, who also watches that she observes ceremony, and who fights off the Disowned orcs beside her.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

pages_say.description: Narset's bodyguard in the original timeline, more loyal to the Jeskai elders than to her.

citation.text: "Narset". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
